events.description: 2. ORDER granting 1 Application for Leave to Proceed in forma pauperis. After consideration by the Court of the affidavit of indigency only, plaintiffs request to proceed in forma pauperis is hereby GRANTED pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1915(a), and he shall be allowed to proceed with this action without prepayment of filing fees, docket costs, or United States Marshals Service fees. However, it is further ORDERED that service of process shall not issue at the present time, and the Clerk shall submit this file to the assigned District Judge for consideration of the request for a restraining order and injunctive relief and for further proceedings, including a frivolity determination under 28 U.S.C. § 1915(e)(2).. Signed by Magistrate Judge Russell G. Vineyard on 11/5/2024. (dgr) (Entered: 11/05/2024)
